articles.description: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel were recognized for their work on light-gated ion channels and optogenetics, a technique that uses pulses of light to activate neurons in the brain.

articles.title: Texas Pediatricians Face Paxton Investigations for Vaccinating Children
articles.description: Ken Paxton, the Texas attorney general and Republican Senate candidate, has alleged a sprawling profit-driven conspiracy. Pediatricians say the accusations are an attempt at intimidation.

articles.title: Are Babies Conscious?
articles.description: By pinpointing when it begins in young humans, scientists hope to better understand what consciousness is, and how it arises, in all of us.
